title: botrychium ternatum var. nipponicum
intro: Botrychium ternatum var. nipponicum, commonly known as Japanese rattlesnake fern, is a variety of the fern species Botrychium ternatum. It is a type of rare, perennial, and deciduous fern native to East Asia, characterized by its unique, pinnate fronds and distinctive rattling sound produced by its spore-bearing fronds. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Japanese rattlesnake fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity.
